title: ttomura's modpack
description: A Vanilla+ modpack focused on exploration, world generation, reworked structures, new biomes, visual improvements, and immersive gameplay features like voice chat and seasons.
body:
Ttomura’s Modpack is a Vanilla+ experience focused on expanding Minecraft without losing its original identity.

The modpack reworks and enhances many vanilla structures, including villages, strongholds, mineshafts, nether fortresses, and end cities, making exploration feel fresh and rewarding again. The world is heavily expanded with 150+ new biomes, redesigned caves, and improved terrain generation that blends naturally with vanilla Minecraft.

Visual immersion is a major focus:

Improved mob textures and animations

GUI tweaks and cleaner interfaces

Subtle visual enhancements that keep the vanilla style

Gameplay additions stay balanced and lightweight, enhancing exploration, building, and survival without turning the game into a tech-heavy experience. The pack also includes proximity voice chat, encouraging multiplayer interaction and immersion.

This modpack is ideal for players who want:

A modern Vanilla+ feel

Massive world variety and exploration

Visual improvements without heavy performance cost

A cohesive and immersive survival experience
